preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 100000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(ai) <= 100000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each string ai must be non-empty and its length must not exceed 100000.
The total length of all strings must not exceed 100000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each output integer must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) <= len(ai) * (len(ai) + 1) // 2 for x, ai in zip(map(int, stdout.split()), a))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must not exceed the maximum number of substrings for the corresponding string.
